{{Short description|British statistician}}
{{Refimprove|date=August 2013}}
'''Herbert Edward Soper''' (1865 – 1930) was a [[British Empire|British]] [[statistician]], who worked with [[Karl Pearson]]. He was awarded the [[Guy Medal|'''Guy Medal in Silver''']] of the [[Royal Statistical Society]] in 1930.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.rss.org.uk/site/cms/contentviewarticle.asp?article=479 |title=The Royal Statistical Society |publisher=Rss.org.uk |date=1996-02-14 |access-date=2013-09-02 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120317045440/http://www.rss.org.uk/site/cms/contentviewarticle.asp?article=479 |archive-date=2012-03-17 }}</ref> He had an obituary in the ''[[Journal of the Royal Statistical Society]]''.<ref>''[[Journal of the Royal Statistical Society]]''; Vol 94 : No 1 p,135 (1931)</ref>
